details:
VRChat Version: Build 1102 (observed since VRChat 2021.2.2 update)

I'm using a Valve Index and three Vive Trackers 1.0 with SteamVR (currently version 1.17.12, but observed since mid-May) on Windows 10 

Description of the bug: On certain avatars, when I switch to them with FBT enabled (requiring a calibration), other people in the world no longer see my position or rig update 

Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?):
1. Start VRChat in VR with full-body tracking pucks.
2. Join a world with other people in it
3. Switch to an affected avatar
4. Calibrate
5. Locally, everything looks fine, but to everyone else you are now stuck wherever you calibrated. They can still *hear* you, and your voice comes from the calibration position, but they can't see you moving around or moving controllers/trackers.

Alternately,

1. Start VRChat in VR with full body tracking
2. Switch to or already be wearing an affected avatar with FBT
3. Have someone else join the instance -- at this point they *can* see the avatar animating  and moving around!! 
4. Recalibrate the avatar
5. Now stuck the same way as in the other repro

Note that this does not reproduce on all avatars! I've only been able to reproduce it so far with two of my personal SDK 3.0 avatars with blueprint IDs:
- avtr_b266d120-2883-41f3-b0aa-fdbc5a72271f
- avtr_d63e5bc0-dfa0-4e57-9a0c-8f69313774c7

 However it happens 100% of the time with these avatars. It has also persisted through reuploads of those avatars.

Most annoyingly: the issue persists through leaving an instance and coming back, changing to a new instance, changing to *different avatars*, and *restarting VRChat*. The only consistent way to fix it is to clear the local profile data *and* restart VRchat, which kicks you back to the tutorial and resets all avatar settings and menu settings. Very annoying.

Any extra files? (output logs, screenshots):

Here is a screen capture of two local instances of VRChat exhibiting the bug. (Launched with the SDK 3.0 worlds "test locally" thing -- these clients are on the same machine in a test instance): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bXdi7UNs3AA

Logs from the two client sessions in the video: 
 - VR Side: https://pastebin.com/hE7yKuFS
 - Desktop Side: https://pastebin.com/dQdxLupR
title: Player position does not synchronize to other people in world after calibrating FBT on some avatars
